events.title: Oasis of Lilies Demo released!
events.summary: Steam Next Fest has begun, bringing new demos to the store in abundance! As announced earlier, Oasis of Lilies participates in the event with a demo of its own! It's now available for download on the store page. Get it now! Or maybe later? It will remain available even after the event has ended. ːbambooleavesːThe demo is about 9100 words or 30-45 minutes long, constituting roughly 10% of the total length of the game. events.title: Oasis of Lilies Demo is coming out October 19th, Full Version in November!
events.summary: Oasis of Lilies is finally nearing its completion; only the endings are still underway! It'll take approximately one month to finish development, so the game will be ready for release next month. The exact release date will be announced later, but it'll be in the latter half of November.But a part of the game will become playable sooner! Oasis of Lilies will participate in the upcoming Steam Next Fest, meaning that a free demo version of the game will become available as soon as the event begins

events.title: Oasis of Lilies announced!
events.summary: The fifth Arcus Plume game, Oasis of Lilies, is coming out later this year! The exact release date is yet to be decided, but it will take a minimum of three months to finish the development. A September or October release seems plausible. This time, we'll follow Ayame, a young university student, who visits a members-only club that provides all manner of services to gentlewomen with refined tastes.
